instruction: Create a new third party named "Nvidia". Fill in only the name and leave every other field at its default value.

checks.name: nvidia_exists_once
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llx_societe WHERE BINARY nom = 'Nvidia'

checks.name: no_extra_fields
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llx_societe WHERE BINARY nom = 'Nvidia' AND COALESCE(name_alias,'') = '' AND COALESCE(address,'') = '' AND COALESCE(zip,'') = '' AND COALESCE(town,'') = '' AND COALESCE(phone,'') = '' AND COALESCE(phone_mobile,'') = '' AND COALESCE(fax,'') = '' AND COALESCE(email,'') = '' AND COALESCE(url,'') = '' AND COALESCE(siren,'') = '' AND COALESCE(siret,'') = '' AND COALESCE(tva_intra,'') = '' AND COALESCE(note_public,'') = '' AND COALESCE(note_private,'') = '' AND fournisseur = 0

checks.name: baseline_customer_intact
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llx_societe WHERE rowid = 1 AND BINARY nom = 'Microsoft' AND status = 1
